usedFor: A Shopify shopper who abandons checkout already has a Freshdesk contact if they write in.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create a Contact” in Freshdesk
bestTemplate.why: It fires only when the shopper entered an email or phone, so the contact showed intent.

watchOut: A contact is made for every abandoner, so the Freshdesk list can grow quickly.
